original_ai_output.title_zh: 德国支持卡焦-凯吉妇女韧性项目
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 德国通过驻朱巴大使馆向当地组织“妇女正义与平等组织”（WOJE）提供资金，用于改善卡焦-凯吉县500名受冲突影响妇女和女童的心理社会福祉与韧性。项目名为“为卡焦-凯吉县受冲突影响妇女和女童恢复尊严并建设韧性”。德国方面表示将持续支持南苏丹人民，并称其为该国第二大双边捐助方。卡焦-凯吉县位于中赤道州，当地的不安全与暴力已导致数千平民流离失所。

key_facts.fact: 德国通过驻朱巴大使馆向WOJE提供资金，用于支持500名受冲突影响的妇女和女童
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Federal Republic of Germany, through its embassy in Juba, has provided funds to a local organization, Women for Justice and Equality (WOJE), to improve the psychosocial well-being and resilience of 500 conflict-affected women and girls

key_facts.fact: 项目名为“为卡焦-凯吉县受冲突影响妇女和女童恢复尊严并建设韧性”
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The project is dubbed “Restoring Dignity and Building Resilience for the conflict-affected women and girls in Kajo-Keji County.”

key_facts.fact: 德国方面称其为南苏丹第二大双边捐助方
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Hofmann reaffirmed Germany’s continued commitment to the People of South Sudan, highlighting its position as the country’s second-largest bilateral donor.

key_facts.fact: 卡焦-凯吉县位于中赤道州，当地不安全与暴力已导致数千平民流离失所
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Kajo-Keji County, Central Equatoria State, faces insecurity and violence that have led to the displacement of thousands of civilians, particularly women and children.

uncertainties: 事件目前仅有一个来源（Radio Tamazuj）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
卡焦-凯吉县流离失所人数的具体数字未在文中给出
